pages.title: Pizza Now!
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Pizza Now! puts you in charge of keeping a busy pizzeria running. Prepare pizzas, deliver orders to customers, and clear the tables so the restaurant stays ready for the next arrivals. Serving food is only one part of the routine: cleanliness and staff management also affect how efficiently you can handle the work.

Spend your earnings on upgrades and expansion, and hire employees to help serve more guests. Progress also opens additional locations and different looks for your character. Develop the business while keeping up with the practical jobs that bring each customer from ordering a pizza to finishing their visit.

pages.title: Autumn Onet Connect
pages.creator: 2Million Games
pages.description:
Autumn Onet Connect is a tile-matching puzzle with an autumn theme. Select a tile, find its identical partner, and remove the pair when a connection is available. Each successful match opens more of the board for the next search.

Look across the remaining pictures for pairs you can connect, then continue clearing them two at a time. The changing layout makes recognizing a matching image and finding an available connection parts of the same puzzle.

pages.title: Cute Animal World
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Build an animal-themed attraction as Senti in Cute Animal World. Develop the park, set up a stage with a cowboy theme, and bring in visitors by handing out flyers. Hiring performers adds music and activity to the place you are managing.

Click and drag to handle the game's interactions as you develop your animal city. The management loop connects attracting an audience with improving what they find when they arrive, giving your building choices and hired entertainers a shared purpose.

pages.title: Survive Lava for Brainrots!
pages.creator: Square Dino LLC
pages.description:
Survive Lava for Brainrots! combines a collection run with a base that you can develop between trips. Run forward to gather Brainrots while keeping ahead of the rising lava. Getting caught by the lava threatens your attempt, so collecting characters also means judging how long you can stay out.

Upgrade your Brainrots to increase what they earn, then improve your base to make room for more of them. Your progress links the danger of each run with the growing collection you can place back at the base.

pages.title: Word Game 2026
pages.creator: Aman Bhai
pages.description:
Word Game 2026 challenges you to complete partially written words against a thirty-second countdown. Examine the letters already shown, work out what is missing, and enter the remaining letters before the timer runs out. If time expires, the level has to be restarted.

Use the keyboard or the game's screen interaction to supply your answers. The collection contains one hundred levels, each keeping the focus on recognizing the incomplete word quickly enough to finish it within the limit.

pages.title: Gloomy Princess Favorite Toy
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description:
Gloomy Princess Favorite Toy lets you style a gothic princess and her favorite teddy companion together. Select makeup, clothes, and accessories for the princess, with choices such as lace corsets and witch hats shaping her appearance. Then give the toy its own personality to complete the pair.

Click or tap the available styling options and experiment with how the two characters look together. Once you have created a combination you want to keep, the game lets you save the finished image as a PNG.

pages.title: Hidden Object: My Hotel
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description:
Hidden Object: My Hotel follows a young woman restoring an old hotel she has just bought. Help her search cluttered rooms for hidden items as part of cleaning up the building and bringing it back into use. Each room turns the renovation into a search through objects and details.

Inspect the scene, select the things you need to find, and use a hint when a difficult object holds up the search. The hotel-restoration story gives the object hunts a setting as you work through its untidy rooms.

pages.title: Screw Sort 3D: Screw Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description:
Screw Sort 3D: Screw Puzzle asks you to sort screws from a three-dimensional model into boxes by color. Look for the color you need, select the matching screws, and send them to the correct container. The model can be moved around to expose screws that are harder to see from the current view.

Use mouse clicks or taps to make your selections. Check the model from different angles as you work through its colors, keeping each box matched with the screws that belong inside it.

pages.title: Digital Aqua
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description:
Digital Aqua is a virtual aquarium where tropical fish swim through underwater landscapes. Manage your tanks, add fish, and use the feeding options to look after the collection. A slideshow feature also lets you view the aquariums as a changing display.

Use the directional keys and Enter or the mouse to operate the menus. Browse the fish and tank options, then return to the aquarium to watch its inhabitants and interact with the feeding controls.

pages.title: Grass Land
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description:
Grass Land sends a grass cutter into fields of dense greenery to uncover what is hidden underneath. Cut through the overgrowth, gather useful resources, and use what you discover to develop your base. Exploring another patch of grass can reveal more materials for that growth.

Control the character with WASD, the arrow keys, or the joystick. Your route through the fields connects cutting and exploration with building, turning the resources beneath the grass into progress back at your base.

pages.title: Meme challenge.io
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description:
Meme challenge.io is a character-identification quiz built around Italian Brainrot memes. Look at the question and choose the correct name, with characters such as Spaghetti Tualetti and Bombardino Crocodilo appearing among the game's references. A timer adds pressure to recognizing the answer.

Use the provided controls to make your choice before the quiz time expires. The main challenge is knowing the unusual character names and selecting the right response quickly enough to keep progressing.

pages.title: Fun Town Parking
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Fun Town Parking challenges you to follow routes and place your vehicle in the assigned spaces without hitting obstacles. The paths become more complicated as you progress, asking for careful steering as well as a clean final parking position.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, and change the gear when you need to move forward or backward. C changes the camera view, giving you another perspective on the approach. Watch the route and the space around the car as you work through each parking layout.

pages.title: Hexa Puzzle Master
pages.creator: s1interactivestudio
pages.description:
Hexa Puzzle Master gives you hexagonal pieces to fit into a board without leaving gaps. Drag each block into place and study how its outline can work with the spaces that remain. The pieces keep their preset orientations, so solving the layout depends on placement rather than rotation.

There is no time limit, letting you examine the fit before making a move. Different difficulty levels provide new arrangements to solve, while running out of valid placements ends the game. Think about the whole grid as you decide where each piece should go.

pages.title: Building Mods For Minecraft
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Building Mods For Minecraft combines block-style construction with combat. Use the available building tools to create structures, then work with guns as you take part in the action. The block-based setting brings the construction tools and weapons together.

Click or tap to interact with the tools and objects. The construction side gives you things to build, while the weapons add combat to the block-based setting.

pages.title: Snake Classic
pages.creator: Fantasy Realm
pages.description:
Snake Classic offers six variations of the familiar snake game: Classic, Box, Tunnel, Mill, Condo, and Rail. Guide the snake toward fruit and gems while avoiding walls and its own tail. Different modes change the setting for that collection-and-survival task.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer, or swipe in the direction you want to travel. Collected items also connect with the game's snake-skin customization. Choose a mode, keep watching the space around your growing route, and try to collect without trapping yourself against an obstacle.

pages.title: Sprunki
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description:
Sprunki is a music-mixing game where characters contribute sounds to a track you create. Drag and drop the available elements onto the characters to combine rhythms and other sounds, then experiment with a different arrangement to change what you hear. The characters respond as their parts enter the mix.

Use the left mouse button or touch controls to move the elements into place. Dragging the black button onto a character switches to the horror theme, giving the same interactive music-making setup a different atmosphere.

pages.title: Color Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Color Sort Puzzle asks you to separate mixed colored water into individual flasks. Select a flask, then another container to pour the color from the top into it. Keep moving the layers until each color has been gathered together in its own flask.

Study the order of the colors before pouring, since moving one layer exposes the next. Power-ups are available if you get stuck. The puzzle is to use the containers and their available space to turn the mixed starting arrangement into a neatly sorted set.

pages.title: Block Stacking
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description:
Block Stacking is a three-dimensional block puzzle about completing layers in a tower. Turn or flip the incoming block formation, then place it onto the stack so it fills the spaces left in the existing arrangement. Complete layers clear away and contribute to your score.

Swipe sideways to rotate the piece, upward to flip it, or downward to place it. Study the tower before committing to a placement so the new blocks help finish a layer instead of leaving awkward gaps for the next formation.

pages.title: Bridge Wars
pages.creator: Felicity Games
pages.description:
Bridge Wars gives you three seconds to draw the formation of your defenders. Your pattern summons stickman soldiers who attack the enemy vehicles trying to cross the bridge. Keep those vehicles from breaking through the barricade and escaping past your defenses.

Between attacks, visit the shop to improve your armor, weapons, and utilities. Stronger equipment prepares your soldiers for heavier vehicles and further waves. The main decisions combine the shape of the force you draw with the upgrades you choose to support it, all focused on stopping the next crossing attempt.

pages.title: Stunt Car Extreme 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Stunt Car Extreme 2 takes car driving onto obstacle courses with sharp turns and moving platforms high above the ground. Navigate the track and complete the stage objective within its time allowance. The course demands careful steering as the platforms and bends change your route.

Finishing stages earns money that can go toward more cars. Work through the driving challenges to expand your vehicle selection, then take another car onto the next demanding course. The combination of a clock and suspended platforms keeps both speed and control relevant to the finish.

pages.title: ASMR Beauty Treatment
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description:
ASMR Beauty Treatment follows a character through a facial and dental makeover before a final fashion session. Help clean her face, work through the blemish and teeth-care activities, and complete the treatment steps presented by the game.

Afterward, choose makeup and an outfit to create the finished look. Use the mouse to interact with the tools and styling choices. The sequence takes the character from the treatment chair to a complete appearance change, linking the care activities with the clothing and cosmetics you select.

pages.title: Granny Pills - Defend Cactuses
pages.creator: Artem Lanin
pages.description:
Defend a granny's roadside cacti from aliens in Granny Pills - Defend Cactuses. In its future-Earth setting, the invaders are trying to destroy the surviving plants, and Granny fights back by throwing pills. The pill's color must match the approaching monster's color to defeat it.

Click and hold to aim, then release to throw. Watch the aliens and choose a matching shot before they reach the cacti. Your goal is to keep the plants protected and survive for as long as possible, making color recognition part of every attack.

pages.title: Idle Arks: Sail and Build 2
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Idle Arks: Sail and Build 2 begins in a world where floodwater has swallowed entire towns. Build a raft, rescue people stranded by the disaster, and bring survivors together into a shipbuilding team. Construction gives you a way to survive and continue exploring the flooded setting.

Click or tap to work through the building and rescue activities. As the team develops its ark, the journey leads toward new places and unfamiliar civilizations. Gathering a crew and improving the vessel connect the immediate survival work with exploring farther across the water.

pages.title: Skibidi Online
pages.creator: Jetti Games AB
pages.description:
Skibidi Online is a multiplayer shooter with competitive and cooperative modes. Battle attacking Skibidi Toilets using melee weapons or guns across ten maps. PvP and co-op provide different ways to take part in the same armed confrontations.

Move with WASD, jump with Space, and click the mouse to attack. E equips a weapon, while Tab displays the statistics. Choose how to approach the fight with the weapon available to you, keeping movement and attacks together as enemies close in across the map.

pages.title: Frog Jump
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Frog Jump places a frog on a wheel that keeps moving while monsters threaten its route. Time your jumps to clear the creatures and stay alive on the rotating surface. Contact with a monster ends the attempt.

Use the mouse or touchpad to control the jumping. Watch how the moving wheel brings the next danger toward you, then choose the moment to leap. Your goal is to keep surviving and build a higher score without letting the frog touch an enemy.

pages.title: Human Gun
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Human Gun turns collected stickmen into the shape of a weapon as you travel along a course. Slide to move, gather more people, and develop the human-built gun while steering around obstacles. Hitting the hazards can bring the attempt to an end.

Money collected on the route lets you buy additional weapons. Watch both the stickmen available ahead and the obstacles around them, balancing the chance to improve your weapon with keeping the run going.

pages.title: Easter Hidden Eggs
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Easter Hidden Eggs challenges you to find ten eggs concealed in each illustrated scene. Search the picture and click or tap an egg when you recognize it among the details. All ten need to be found before that level's timer expires.

The game contains eight levels, with the clock shown at the lower right of the screen. Work through the image methodically, checking the places you have not searched yet while keeping enough time to locate the remaining eggs.

pages.title: Toy Car Gear Race
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description:
Toy Car Gear Race is a drag-racing game where well-timed gear changes decide your progress. Watch the gear meter and click or tap to shift at the right moment, keeping your toy car moving ahead of the competition. Leaving it in the same gear for too long can make it catch fire.

Keep checking the meter as the car accelerates. Each shift becomes a timing decision between continuing to build speed and changing gear before the engine starts to burn.

pages.title: New Daily Sudoku
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
New Daily Sudoku provides a fresh number puzzle each day and a calendar of earlier puzzles to revisit. Fill the nine-by-nine board so every row, column, and three-by-three region contains each digit from one through nine once. The numbers already on the grid provide the starting constraints.

Choose a difficulty that suits the challenge you want, then compare the rows, columns, and regions before entering another number. The calendar lets you select a previous date when you want an additional puzzle beyond the current day's board.

pages.title: Squid Runner
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description:
Squid Runner sends you through dangerous locations in a series of survival challenges. Change lanes to navigate the route, avoid capture, and try to complete the games standing between you and the jackpot. Surviving the full sequence is the overall objective.

Swipe or use the arrow keys to move between lanes. Keep watching what is ahead as each location presents another challenge to get through, with your next move focused on staying in the contest.

pages.title: Raid Heroes: Total War
pages.creator: PERSONA•GAMES
pages.description:
Raid Heroes: Total War combines hero development, castle management, and battles against the Dark Lord's forces. Assemble a squad, improve its artifacts, and work through the story while developing the castle in your township. Reforging equipment gives you another way to strengthen the group you send into combat.

The game also includes attacks on other players' castles, a PvP arena for hero squads, and clans that can join the wider war. Prepare your team for automatic battles, protect your own castle, and choose where to invest in the heroes and equipment that support your campaign.

pages.title: Cyberpunk World: Resistance
pages.creator: justaliendev
pages.description:
Cyberpunk World: Resistance puts you at the head of a squad opposing a cyber-police takeover. The city is surrounded and an assault is coming, so fight the forces trying to seize control. Use the available weapons and movement abilities to support the resistance.

Move with WASD, fire with the left mouse button, and change weapons with the mouse wheel. Left Shift runs, C crouches, and Space jumps. Press Space twice to use the jetpack, adding vertical movement to your options during the fighting.

pages.title: Just Farm
pages.creator: Brutal Dack Games
pages.description:
Just Farm puts sheep at the center of building your own pasture. Buy animals, raise them, sell their wool, and work toward breeding different kinds of sheep. Trading livestock and collecting chicken eggs add more jobs to the farm's routine.

Complete level tasks to earn their bonuses while developing the land and animals you manage. The cycle of caring for sheep and selling what they produce gives you a way to grow the pasture, with each task directing the next part of your farming work.

pages.title: Marbles Garden
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description:
Marbles Garden is a marble shooter in which golems push a line of balls toward the hole at the end of a path. Fire colored projectiles into the line to create matching groups of at least three and remove them before they reach the exit.

Completing a level awards a star. Spend those stars to activate or improve special projectiles and other power-ups, giving you more ways to destroy the advancing balls. Keep the chain away from the hole while using your upgrades to protect the garden from the golems.

pages.title: Run Destiny Choice
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Run Destiny Choice makes the direction of your run part of choosing between an angel and a demon. Guide the character through the course and make the choices that shape the final outcome. What you decide along the way affects which side of that transformation you reach.

Slide to move and keep watching the options ahead. The running challenge is tied to those decisions, so your route also determines the destiny the character takes on.

pages.title: Pop It Nums
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Pop It Nums combines a pop-it board with number-category puzzles. Read the requirement for the level, then pop the bubbles containing numbers that meet it. Tasks include recognizing positive values, prime numbers, even numbers, and other mathematical categories.

Use the mouse or touchpad to select the correct bubbles. The objective is to clear the numbers that satisfy the current rule, making the label for each level as important as the values printed on the bubbles.

pages.title: Join and Clash Battle
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description:
Join and Clash Battle asks you to free imprisoned warriors while traveling toward a fight with a monster. Rescue the fighters along the route and keep clear of the deadly obstacles between you and the end. The warriors you save become part of the confrontation waiting there.

Use the mouse, WASD, or the arrow keys to move through the course. Survive the approach, gather the rescued group, and defeat the monster to complete the stage. The game offers fifty or more levels built around that rescue-and-battle sequence.

pages.title: Big Bad Ape
pages.creator: gametornado
pages.description:
Big Bad Ape lets you control a giant ape that has escaped a testing facility. Rampage through city streets, the seaport, and other locations, smashing cars and buildings while attacking the people in your path. Armed humans can fight back, adding danger to the destruction.

Use the game's keyboard-and-mouse or touch controls to guide the creature through its escape. Keep an eye on anyone carrying a gun as you tear through the surroundings, balancing the rampage with surviving the resistance it provokes.

pages.title: Drawmaster
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description:
Drawmaster turns each attack into a path-drawing puzzle. Draw a route for the weapon to follow, then make sure that route carries it into the enemy. The line you create determines how the attack travels through the level.

Study the target's position before drawing and shape the route around the layout. The game includes more than twenty weapons and at least thirty levels, giving you different attacks and arrangements to solve with the same idea: plan the weapon's journey so it reaches its mark.

pages.title: Winter Differences
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Winter Differences presents pairs of almost identical winter pictures with small changes hidden between them. Compare the two scenes and select each difference you find. Hints are available when a detail proves difficult to locate.

The score rewards more than simply completing the search: remaining time and unused hints contribute to the bonus. Work across the pictures carefully before requesting help, checking corresponding objects and outlines so you can finish with more of those resources left.

pages.title: Pretty Tiles
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description:
Pretty Tiles is a matching puzzle where selecting three tiles with identical shapes removes them. Examine the pictures on the tiles, find a set of three, and tap the matching pieces to clear that group.

Some tiles are labeled as timed targets. Match three of those within the stated interval to receive a reward. Watch for the labeled sets while looking through the board, combining ordinary matches with the special opportunities that appear under a time limit.

pages.title: Halloween Blocks
pages.creator: KTV
pages.description:
Halloween Blocks gives a falling-block puzzle a Halloween setting. Move and rotate the descending shapes to complete rows and clear space, trying to build a higher score while keeping the board under control.

Use the left and right arrow keys to position a shape, Up to rotate it, and Down to make it descend faster. Touch controls use corresponding swipes. Think about where the piece will settle before accelerating its fall so the next shape has useful space available.

pages.title: Polar Fall
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description:
Polar Fall sends Mr. Bear downward through a world filled with Christmas trees. Click to change his direction between left and right, steering the fall away from the obstacles. The objective is to get as far down as possible without letting the bear hit a tree.

Collect abilities that can shuffle the world as you descend. Watch the route below Mr. Bear and adjust his direction for the next opening, keeping the falling journey going while the arrangement around him changes.

pages.title: Among run
pages.creator: Flikes Games
pages.description:
Among run is a survival runner starring an impostor-style character. Keep the run going, jump past danger, and collect coins along the way. Tap anywhere to jump, choosing your moment as the route brings the next threat into view.

Coins let you open additional character skins, while twelve achievements provide more goals to pursue. Try to extend each attempt long enough to improve your score and collect more coins without losing the runner to the course's hazards.

pages.title: Rotate Soccer
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description:
Rotate Soccer is a physics puzzle in which you turn the level to guide a soccer ball toward the goal. Touch and drag to rotate the layout, changing how the ball travels through the course. Getting the ball into the net completes the main objective.

Study the position of the ball and goal before turning the scene. Adjust the angle as the ball moves so the layout carries it where you need it, using rotation to solve each soccer-themed puzzle.

pages.title: Piggy In The Puddle
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description:
Piggy In The Puddle asks you to get a pig into a mud-filled bathtub by changing its shape. Switch the pig into a round form to make it roll and fall through the level, then return it to a square shape when you need it to stop.

Food can be collected along the route, adding another reason to choose when the pig should roll. Use the two forms to manage its movement and work out how to reach the bath in each layout without rolling past the place you need to stop.

pages.title: Hexa Cars
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Hexa Cars is a driving survival game where the goal is to be the last vehicle left without falling out of the arena. Different maps change the space you have to work with, and collected coins let you unlock more cars.

Play alone or with a second player. In solo play, use the arrow keys to drive and Space to jump. For two players, the first uses WASD and Q, while the second uses the arrows and Space. Keep your car moving through the available space and use jumps to help it stay in the contest.

pages.title: Snow Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Snow Cars Jigsaw offers twelve pictures of cars in snowy settings to assemble. Select an image and a difficulty before starting: the easy puzzle has twenty-five pieces, medium has forty-nine, and hard has one hundred.

Use the mouse or touch controls to fit the pieces into the complete picture. The difficulty choice changes how finely the scene is divided, letting you work on the same winter-car theme with either larger sections or a more detailed collection of pieces.

pages.title: Merge and Fly
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Merge and Fly makes aircraft upgrades part of running an airport business. Combine two planes to produce a better model, then drag planes onto the runway to earn coins. The aircraft you operate supply the income for the next round of improvements.

Use the shop to improve earning capacity, speed, and plane quality. Decide how to balance the aircraft currently making money with the opportunity to merge them into better ones, developing a runway operation built around increasingly valuable planes.

pages.title: Sudoku Village
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Sudoku Village gives you a nine-by-nine number grid with some entries already filled in. Complete the empty cells so every horizontal row, vertical column, and three-by-three box uses the digits one to nine without a repeat. The starting numbers remain the clues that constrain the rest of the board.

Compare a cell's row, column, and box before choosing its value. Continue placing numbers that satisfy all three groups until the entire puzzle is filled and every group contains a complete set.

pages.title: Smack Dat Ex
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Smack Dat Ex is an interactive cartoon brawl between a former couple. Use the mouse to select attacks for the boyfriend or girlfriend and watch the resulting animated sequence. Their health bars fall as the chosen blows land.

Keep choosing actions to play out the confrontation. Draining one character's health opens a finishing sequence, giving the exaggerated breakup a slapstick ending shaped by the attacks you selected.

pages.title: Grenade Toss
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Grenade Toss gives you enemies to defeat with a limited supply of explosives. Adjust the direction and strength of a throw, then send the grenade toward its target. Each level limits how many grenades you can use, so a missed throw spends part of the same allowance needed to finish the fight.

Judge the enemy's position before committing to the throw. Aim for an angle and power that carry the grenade into useful range, and keep checking how many explosives remain.

pages.title: Blocky Warfare the Aweper Zombie
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description:
Blocky Warfare the Aweper Zombie is a multiplayer shooting game set on block-built maps. Fight with a selection of guns and attachments in pixel-styled environments, including an ice-themed map. The weapon collection gives you different equipment to work with during the battles.

Move with WASD and use the mouse to aim, look around, fire, and change guns. Space jumps, Shift runs, and Left Ctrl takes the character prone. Q changes camouflage, while Tab opens the menu. Combine those movement options with your selected weapon as you navigate the blocky terrain.

pages.title: Subway Bullet Train Simulator
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description:
Subway Bullet Train Simulator puts you in control of a passenger train traveling through city railway routes and underground tunnels. Manage its speed, slow down for sharp turns, and stop to collect passengers and deliver them to their destinations. Watching the track and its stopping points matters as much as accelerating.

Use W and S or the up and down arrow keys to increase and reduce speed. H sounds the horn. Camera-view changes let you choose a perspective while operating the train, helping you monitor the route and prepare for the next stop.

pages.title: Ranger Action
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Ranger Action sends a ranger against zombies attacking from both the ground and the air. Use a shotgun and special abilities that include lightning, ice, and a firestorm to fight the enemies. Collect coins, items, and improvements as you continue through the action.

Press the up arrow to jump and Space to shoot, or use the touch controls. Watch for threats above as well as ahead of the ranger, combining jumps and gunfire while using the abilities available to deal with the next group.

pages.title: Hero Knight Action RPG
pages.creator: PowerSlash Studios
pages.description:
Hero Knight Action RPG follows a sword-wielding knight through fights with monsters. Earn experience to level up, collect gold and gems, and improve your attributes and skills. Sword attacks and spells provide different ways to handle the enemies along the route.

Holding the attack button for about two seconds charges a Power Slash. Health and magic potions restore half of their respective meters, so using one below half avoids wasting part of its recovery. Click the combat buttons to attack, and use A or S for the red or blue potion. A hidden firebird encounter also offers a route to the Legendary Fire Knight transformation.

pages.title: Bicycle Tuk Tuk Auto Rickshaw Free Driving Game
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description:
Bicycle Tuk Tuk Auto Rickshaw Free Driving Game focuses on transporting passengers in a tuk-tuk. Drive to the pickup location, collect your passengers, and take them to the requested destination. Routes include city driving and off-road surroundings.

The game offers a free-driving mode and a career mode with challenges to accept. Use the free mode to explore how the rickshaw handles, then work through the passenger jobs in the career. Picking people up and delivering them connects the driving to a clear transport task.

pages.title: Jewels And Monster
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description:
Jewels And Monster is a physics puzzle where jewels support a monster above the ground. Tap jewels to destroy them and let gravity move the pieces that remain. Your objective is to bring the monster down to the ground by choosing which supports to remove.

Look at the stack before tapping. Removing one jewel can change how the rest of the arrangement falls, so plan the order of the removals around where the monster will land.

pages.title: Night Car Parking Simulator
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description:
Night Car Parking Simulator takes you through car-parking courses in a nighttime setting. Follow the driving layout, steer around its cones and barrels, and line the car up with the parking destination. Careful steering matters as you set up the final parking position.

Drive with the arrow keys and use Space to brake. Slow the approach as the available space narrows, then adjust the car's position to complete the parking task.

pages.title: Vegas Revenge
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description:
Vegas Revenge combines driving with armed missions across twenty timed levels. Complete the task for the current stage before its allowance runs out, switching between movement and combat as the mission requires. Finishing the objective lets you advance to the next level.

Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and Q to roll. The left mouse button fires and the right button aims, while E or 1 changes weapons. Keep the mission goal and remaining time in mind as you work through the shooting and driving challenges.

pages.title: Motocross Beach Game : Bike Stunt Racing
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description:
Motocross Beach Game : Bike Stunt Racing sends you over beach and road courses on a stunt motorcycle. Ride through every required checkpoint and perform the course's jumps while trying to finish before the level's timer expires. Missing the route or taking too long prevents you from completing the task.

Watch the next checkpoint as you approach each section of track. The challenge combines lining up the bike for jumps with covering the course quickly enough to reach all the markers within the allotted time.

pages.title: Letter Shapes
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Letter Shapes is a drag-and-drop recognition game with letters and matching silhouettes. Look at the shape of a character, then drag it onto the outline where it belongs. The game responds to a correct match and lets you try again when a piece is placed on the wrong target.

Use the mouse or touch controls to move the pieces. Compare the curves and straight edges of each letter with the available outlines as you work through the matching activities.

pages.title: Car Stunt Races Mega Ramps
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description:
Car Stunt Races Mega Ramps offers a selection of cars for driving across demanding stunt tracks. Choose a vehicle and use the keyboard arrows to control it through the course. Manage the car's movement as you tackle each part of the track.

Try the available cars while working through the driving layouts, keeping your steering controlled as the route changes around each stunt section.

pages.title: Cheese Casserole
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description:
Cheese Casserole is a guided cooking game in which you help a mother prepare a surprise meal for her two children. Work through the kitchen instructions to prepare the ingredients, combine them, and cook the cheesy dish. Mixing bowls, utensils, and the oven form part of the preparation sequence.

Use the prompted objects in the order the game presents them. The task follows the casserole through its cooking stages, giving you an active part in making the meal before it is ready for the family.

pages.title: BTS Kids Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
BTS Kids Puzzle offers picture puzzles and a dot-to-dot activity. Choose the puzzle you want to work on, then assemble the picture pieces or connect the dots to complete the drawing. The collection gives you different ways to work toward a finished image.

Use the mouse or touch controls to interact with the selected activity. The picture-puzzle options include difficulty choices, while the dot-to-dot section asks you to follow the connections that form the drawing.

pages.title: Mommy Home Recovery
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Mommy Home Recovery follows a pregnant character resting at home after a stay in the hospital. Help with her daily needs by preparing a shake, offering fruit, and playing music to keep her entertained. The game also includes giving her medicine as part of its prompted care routine.

Tap the items needed for each activity and work through the requests as they appear. The focus is on keeping Mommy comfortable and occupied while helping with the things she cannot manage alone during her recovery.

pages.title: Stickman Bouncing
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description:
Stickman Bouncing challenges you to guide a bouncing stick figure as far as possible. Use the arrow keys to control the character and look for golden tubes, which provide a boost that helps you jump higher and travel farther.

Watch the next part of the route as the stickman keeps bouncing. Making use of a golden tube can extend the journey, giving you a chance to improve the distance reached before the attempt ends.

pages.title: Earth Attack
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description:
Earth Attack puts the planet under fire from incoming asteroids and other planets. Rotate Earth with the keyboard to direct its defense and shoot the approaching objects before they strike. Your task is to keep the globe protected as threats arrive around it.

Watch the direction of the next incoming object and adjust your aim to meet it. Shooting early enough gives you a chance to remove the danger before it reaches Earth.

pages.title: Christmas Bubbles Match 3
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Christmas Bubbles Match 3 asks you to collect particular ornaments by making matches. Check the snow globe to see which bubble types the level requires, then use the mouse to move the ornaments and form matching groups.

Each level gives you a limited number of moves. Concentrate on the types shown in the globe so your matches contribute to the target before that allowance runs out. Completing the requested collection is what lets you finish the current Christmas puzzle.

pages.title: Ice Queen Romantic New Years Eve
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Ice Queen Romantic New Years Eve follows the Ice Queen and her boyfriend through a celebration together. Use the interactive activities to help the couple share kisses and affectionate moments before enjoying the fireworks. The evening's small romantic interactions form the main sequence of the game.

Click or tap the available choices to continue their time together. Work through the couple's celebration as they spend the last part of New Year's Eve in each other's company.

pages.title: Dirt Bike Extreme Stunts
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description:
Dirt Bike Extreme Stunts sends you onto off-road motorcycle tracks to race and perform stunts. Guide the bike over the course while keeping control through the uneven route and stunt sections. The challenge comes from handling the motorcycle at speed on demanding terrain.

Use WASD to control the bike, with W for acceleration and S for braking. Adjust your pace as you approach another stunt so you can tackle the track while keeping the motorcycle under control.

pages.title: Indian Challenger Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Indian Challenger Puzzle contains six images of the Indian Challenger motorcycle to rebuild as jigsaws. Each picture is available in four sizes: sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces. Choose the motorcycle image and piece count before beginning the assembly.

Use the mouse to fit the sections together into the complete picture. A lower piece count gives you larger parts to recognize, while the more detailed modes divide the bike and its surroundings into many smaller sections.

pages.title: Candy Blast
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description:
Candy Blast asks you to trace chains of matching sweets on a colorful board. Select at least three candies of the same kind, connect them, and release to collect the group. Each chain adds to your score while new matches become available.

The game runs against a timer, and longer connections can add time as well as award more points. Look for a useful chain before starting your selection, balancing a quick match with the chance to collect a larger group.

pages.title: Lovely Christmas Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Lovely Christmas Puzzle gives you six Christmas-themed pictures to assemble from jigsaw pieces. Select a festive image and choose between four piece counts, ranging from sixteen pieces through thirty-six and sixty-four to one hundred. Each count changes the size and number of sections you need to fit together.

Work with the mouse to rebuild the selected picture. Compare the colors and details along adjoining pieces as you fill in the holiday scene and complete the image.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Siblings Day
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description:
Baby Hazel Siblings Day joins Hazel and her brother Matt for a day of gifts and play. Help the siblings make presents for each other, then accompany them to the playroom for activities including a toy-car ride, a seesaw, and popping colorful bubbles.

Use the mouse to respond to their needs and interact with the characters and objects. Treats and a game of peekaboo add more moments to the celebration. Keeping both children happy connects the different activities as Hazel and Matt spend the day together.

pages.title: Colours and Designs Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Colours and Designs Puzzle turns six images of colors and designs into jigsaw challenges. Pick a picture and decide how finely it should be divided: the available modes use sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces.

Use the mouse to bring the sections together, comparing their colors and patterns to find where each belongs. The same image can be assembled as a shorter puzzle or a more detailed one, depending on the piece count you select.

pages.title: Panda Space Adventure
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description:
Panda Space Adventure puts a panda in a small spaceship for a battle against enemy bears. Control the craft, shoot the enemies, and collect the money that appears during the fighting. The objective is to clear the hostile forces while keeping the panda's ship in the action.

Use the mouse or touch controls to guide your play. Watch the opponents as you collect money, balancing your route through the fight with getting into position to attack.

pages.title: Offroad Mania
pages.creator: Active Games
pages.description:
Offroad Mania is a vehicle-physics driving game with one hundred and twenty obstacle-filled trails. Take a four-wheel-drive car over rocks, bridges, ramps, and other features that test how you guide it through uneven ground. Five vehicles are available, with customization for both the car and driver.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to accelerate, brake, and steer. C changes the camera, while R restarts the attempt. Adjust the view and your speed for the next obstacle as you work out how to get the vehicle across each trail.

pages.title: Real Car Parking Drive
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Real Car Parking Drive gives you car-parking layouts to navigate and finish. Drive through the course, keep the vehicle clear of obstacles, and bring it into the parking destination. Each completed layout moves the focus to another parking approach.

Use WASD to drive and Space to brake. Adjust the car's position before the final approach, using controlled steering and braking to line it up with the space. The task is to complete the parking maneuver through the course provided.

pages.title: Grass Cutter
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description:
Grass Cutter gives you a blade-equipped cutter to guide through overgrown lawns. Move through the grass to mow it down and clear the areas your route passes over. The task keeps the focus on directing the cutter through the greenery.

Press Space to start and use the arrow keys to move. Watch the patches that still need cutting as you choose where to steer next, working the blades through more of the lawn as you continue playing.

pages.title: Pino
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description:
Pino asks you to catch as many fish as possible while avoiding the bombs mixed in with them. Use the mouse to guide your play and keep the fish from dropping past you. Missing too many brings the game to an end.

Watch both the fish you want and the bombs you need to leave alone. The attempt ends after more than three fish have been missed, making each catch part of keeping the run alive as well as adding to your total.

pages.title: Let's Kill Jane The Killer: Don't Go to Sleep
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Let's Kill Jane The Killer: Don't Go to Sleep sends you after eight bottles of Liquid Hate while trying to defeat Jane. Search for the bottles and use your weapon against the threat in this horror shooting game. The collection objective gives you something to find while dealing with the enemy.

Move with WASD, aim and shoot with the mouse, and press R to reload. Keep track of your search as you move through the setting, making room to fight while working toward the full set of eight bottles.

pages.title: Merge Weapons
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Merge Weapons starts with a board of weapon slots and the task of combining matching equipment into stronger versions. Drag together two identical weapons to produce the next tier, and click the chest to make new weapons appear faster. The growing collection opens up more powerful choices.

A separate shooting mode lets you put a selected weapon to use against targets through regular and boss stages. Return to the board to create better weapons or improve the ones you have. Managing the slot space and developing your equipment connects the merging puzzle with the shooting challenges.

pages.title: Bella Pony Hairstyle
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description:
Bella Pony Hairstyle lets you change Bella's hair and choose a new outfit. Choose a hairstyle, change the hair color, and then select clothes to match the result. The hair and wardrobe choices combine into the look you create for her.

Use the mouse to explore the available options. Try different combinations of hairstyle, color, and clothing before settling on the finished appearance, keeping the hair choices at the center of Bella's makeover.

pages.title: Happy Snakes
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Happy Snakes puts you in control of a growing snake moving around an arena. Guide it toward food to increase its size while keeping clear of other snakes. Their bodies create hazards that can bring your journey to an end.

Move the mouse to steer and press to use a speed boost. Extra speed helps you change your position quickly, but it also gives you less time to react to what is ahead. Keep collecting food while watching the space available for your next turn.

pages.title: Zombie Shooter
pages.creator: c2gamesstudio
pages.description:
Zombie Shooter asks you to eliminate the zombies with well-directed bullets. A shot can hit a target directly or reach it after bouncing, making the angle of the attack part of the puzzle. Your objective is to clear every zombie from the level.

Look at the targets and the surfaces around them before choosing where to shoot. A rebound can provide another route to a zombie that is harder to reach with a straight shot, giving you more than one way to solve the arrangement.

pages.title: Sunset Tic Tac Toe
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Sunset Tic Tac Toe offers a game against the computer or a friend. Take turns choosing empty cells and try to place three of your marks in one straight line, whether horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. The first player to complete a line wins.

Watch the opponent's placements as well as your own. An empty cell may help you build a winning line, block one the other player is preparing, or do both at once as the board fills.

pages.title: Galactic Cop
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Galactic Cop is a two-dimensional platform shooter about stopping prisoners escaping from space custody. Move through the fighting area, collect different weapons, and use them against the continuing groups of alien enemies. The weapon pickups give you more ways to deal with the escapees.

Use the arrow keys or WASD to move, and fire with the mouse, N, or Z. Keep watching for another weapon as well as the next group of prisoners, combining movement through the platforms with keeping the attackers under pressure.

pages.title: Princess Winter Olympics
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Princess Winter Olympics is a dress-up game preparing Elsa, Anna, Ariel, Moana, and Jasmine for the closing ceremony. Choose warm outfits for each princess, then complete the look with items such as boots, ski goggles, and helmets. The winter-sports celebration provides the theme for the wardrobe.

Pick a medal for each character before the final group picture. Your task is to style the five winners, coordinating their winter clothing and accessories so each has a finished look for the ceremony.

pages.title: Chilly Snow Ball
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description:
Chilly Snow Ball is a downhill survival game in which you guide a snowball between pine trees. Keep its route clear as the snowy scenery scrolls past, trying to travel farther without crashing into a tree or the boundary. A collision stops the attempt.

Use the pointer or touch controls to adjust the ball's course. Watch the opening ahead before changing direction, keeping the ball moving through the gaps while building a higher score.

pages.title: Bob The Robber 4 Season 2: Russia
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description:
Bob The Robber 4 Season 2: Russia takes Bob into secured buildings for a new set of heists. Search for money, work through locked doors, and avoid the guards, cameras, and laser security protecting the rooms. Getting through the building requires both exploring and dealing with its defenses.

Use the arrow keys to control Bob and follow the displayed instructions when a gadget or interaction becomes available. Door codes, locks, and security devices give you different problems to solve as you look for loot and work toward completing the heist.

pages.title: La pastelera
pages.creator: Merka20
pages.description:
La pastelera is a cake-collecting action game where the treats do not all have the same effect. Gather cakes that add points and avoid the kinds that subtract from your score. Stars provide extra lives, while enemy sheep need to be brought down.

Pay attention to what you are collecting instead of treating every cake as a bonus. Work around the sheep, look for useful stars, and keep adding positive-scoring cakes to your total as you continue through the action.

pages.title: Park a Lot 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Park a Lot 3 puts you in the role of Parker, looking after customers' cars at a busy parking lot. Take vehicles into the lot, keep track of where they are parked, and bring them back when their owners need them. Returning the right car is the service your customers are waiting for.

Use the keyboard to control Parker as you move between the vehicles and their owners. Handling arrivals and retrievals together turns the parking area into a task of organizing cars and finding them again when requested.

pages.title: Princess Sofia Magic Night!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Princess Sofia Magic Night! prepares Sofia for a royal ball at her palace. Browse the outfit choices and select the look you want her to wear for the celebration. Dressing the princess is the main activity as she gets ready to be the center of the event.

Try the available clothing combinations to shape her final appearance. The palace-ball setting gives the wardrobe choices their occasion, letting you put together a finished party outfit for Sofia.
